name: Theme Modal
description: Theme selection dialog opened from Tools > Theme. Presents radio buttons for base palette (Default, Monokai, Idol) and mode (Dark, Light) with Cancel/Apply buttons. On Apply, calls theme.setTheme() with the selected values and triggers canvas refresh/theme update. Reads current theme state from the singleton for default selection. Escape key or clicking overlay dismisses without applying.

dependencies.usage: Reads theme.base and theme.mode for default radio selection; calls theme.setTheme() on apply

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Builds modal overlay with theme/mode radio groups and Cancel/Apply buttons

methods.name: open
methods.description: Displays modal with current theme pre-selected and optional on-close callback
